text:
priya shah: quick triage — new model submission: Rainbow-v2 (open weights repo link in intake). Need: license compatibility, export control flags, quantization feasibility (int8/4), quick eval for regressions vs. our baseline, and a recommended priority for bring-up. who can take point?

derek chen: I can run the first quantization pass and perf smoke. planning to try PTQ int8 + bitsandbytes 4-bit and run calma evals later. ETA for initial numbers: today EOD.

marta ruiz: tagging legal — main thing is license text references "non-commercial" in a paragraph. need to see full license file and any model-card exceptions. if NC present, we probably can't host in hosted offering. will confirm after reading.

sarah nguyen: FYI infra: Rainbow-v2 checkpoint is ~60GB fp16. For private deploy it's fine, for dedicated/hosted we'd either need quant or sharded storage. estimate 2x GPU memory if left fp16.

jake lomax: I'll queue the eval suite (SQuAD / SummBench / our latency-quality probe). Quick note: last time similar family had hallucination uptick at long context. will include 8k context passes.

derek chen: starting PTQ now. command I'm using locally:

```bash
python tools/quantize.py --model ./rainbow-v2 --out ./rainbow-v2-q --bits 8 --method ptq --calib_samples 512
```

will post loss/ll metrics + token throughput.

marta ruiz: read LICENSE.md — it's a Creative Commons variant with a "non-commercial" clause plus attribution requirement. legal-bot confirm?

legal-bot: Automated license scan result: flagged_non_commercial_clause, attribution_required. See intake link for full report.

priya shah: ok that's a blocker for hosted + dedicated public customers. we should still continue PPQ/bench on private-only assumption. prioritize: private-deploy test first, hosted later if license cleared by model authors or license change.

carl ops: rough infra sizing for private-only: for int8 we can target one A10G per replica with ~30 req/s p95 latency goal. If no int8, need A100 80GB or GPU tiling.

derek chen: PTQ int8 finished: perplexity delta +1.2 vs baseline on validation subset, throughput x2 on A10G. 4-bit bnb crashed on our first pass (OOM); trying 4-bit with low-rank-adapter disabling.

jake lomax: eval snapshots: Rouge and exact-match stable on short context, but notable drop on long-context summarization tests (~6% rouge reduction). logging examples in drive link.

marta ruiz: to move forward with hosted/dedicated we need author permission or a license exemption documented. for private deployment customers we can proceed but must label it "private-only" in model catalog and block hosted routing.

priya shah: checklist so far: 1) legal: obtain permission or acceptable license path (marta) 2) ML: finalize quantization profile & stability (derek) 3) Evals: regression triage, targeted prompts (jake) 4) Infra: sizing + image packaging (sarah/carl) 5) Product: catalog visibility & routing policy (I'll loop in product).

derek chen: next steps — try mixed-quant (int8 KV cache + 4-bit weights) and drop calibration samples to 128 to see if 4-bit passes. will test hf-transformers quant wrapper next.

jake lomax: I'll run targeted RLHF regression checks and create a small prompt-set to detect the long-context failures; will attach to the regression alert once ready.

marta ruiz: I'll draft a short "license summary" note and recommended containment policy (private-only) by tomorrow morning.

sarah nguyen: packaging note — need to ensure model artifacts have clear provenance and license file bundled to satisfy audits. I'll add a packaging checklist item.

priya shah: thanks all. assigning follow-ups: derek (quant + perf) | jake (eval regressions + examples) | marta (legal summary) | sarah (packaging + deployment constraints). We'll reconvene in #eng-ml tomorrow 10:30am PT. :thumbsup:

legal-bot: Reminder: export-control screening pending — user flagged potential dual-use terms. Legal will review.

priya shah: adding priority: medium-high for private pilot, low for hosted until license clears. closing this triage thread for now; reopen if any blocker changes.
